title: Hosted API costing by query-shape & region (query-scan)
body:
Purpose:
Quick exploratory workbook to map per-query token economics across realistic query shapes and regional cost multipliers. This sheet is intended to: (a) show per-slice COGS and margin by model family and region, (b) surface routing opportunities where cheaper model + batching or cache can preserve quality, (c) produce simple knobs for ops: batch_size, cache_ttl, model_fallback_priority.

How to read this sheet (layout):
- Rows represent workload slices (query shapes). Each slice is a cluster of requests with similar prompt + completion length and SLA needs.
- Columns are a mix of observed metrics (invocations, tokens), cost inputs (region GPU $/hr, amortized infra), and outputs (est_ppk_usd, est_margin_pct).
- The sheet contains scenario toggles near the top: baseline / aggressive_batch / high_cache / regional_shift. Change scenario selector to recompute est_ppk.

Key assumptions (editable cells at top):
- GPU_hour_cost_by_region: us-east=2.60, eu-west=3.10, ap-sin=3.40 (USD per GPU-hour effective amortized infra + license)
- Model throughput (tokens/sec) @ typical sequence length: redwood-small=2500 t/s, redwood-medium=4800 t/s, llamaX-large=3800 t/s
- Avg tokens processed per hour per GPU = throughput * 3600 * utilization_factor (utilization default = 0.72)
- Storage amortization per request = 0.00002 USD (prefix/kv store, metrics)
- Network egress + infra ops = 0.00006 USD per request on hosted API baseline
- Cost per token from external model license (rare) treated as 0.0 here — handled in separate sheet
- Cache hit reduces completion token generation by at least claimed fraction (cache_hit_reduction).

Sample formula references (as implemented in the sheet):
- tokens_per_gpu_hour = throughput_tps * 3600 * utilization
- gpu_cost_per_token = region_gpu_hour_cost / tokens_per_gpu_hour
- estimated_tokens_per_invocation = avg_prompt_tokens + avg_completion_tokens
- est_cogs_per_invocation = (estimated_tokens_per_invocation * gpu_cost_per_token) + storage_amort_per_request + network_egr_per_request
- est_ppk_usd = (est_cogs_per_invocation * 1000) / 1  (i.e. per 1000 requests or per 1000 tokens depending on slice denomination)
- est_margin_pct = (price_per_unit - est_ppk_usd) / price_per_unit * 100

Top-level knobs (editable):
- Scenario: baseline | aggressive_batch | high_cache | regional_shift
- batch_size_multiplier: 1.0 (aggressive_batch = 1.7)
- cache_hit_rate_global: 0.12 (high_cache = 0.35)
- fallback_model_penalty: extra latency/quality factor when routing to smaller model (0.15 cost uplift if apply safety-quality buffer)

Table: workload slices (columns). Example rows included.
Columns: slice_id, query_shape_label, avg_prompt_tokens, avg_completion_tokens, avg_tokens_per_invocation, avg_latency_sla_ms, model_family_preferred, monthly_invocations, observed_cache_hit_rate, region_mix_us_east, region_mix_eu_west, region_mix_ap_sin, chosen_sku, throughput_tps_assumed, tokens_per_gpu_hour, gpu_cost_per_token_usd, storage_amort_usd, network_egr_usd, est_cogs_per_invocation_usd, price_per_1000_invocations_usd, est_ppk_usd, est_margin_pct, notes

Rows (examples):
1, short-chat, 12, 18, 30, 120, redwood-small, 9,000,000, 0.08, 0.58,0.25,0.17, redwood-small-v2, 2500, 6,480,000, 0.000402, 0.00002, 0.00006, 0.01202, 6.00, 12.02, -100.3, low-value short-turn chat: candidate for prefix caching and aggressive batching at 50ms slack
2, long-form-generation, 30, 420, 450, 1200, redwood-medium, 120,000, 0.03, 0.72,0.20,0.08, redwood-medium-v1, 4800, 12,441,600, 0.000249, 0.00002, 0.00006, 0.11256, 120.00, 112.56, 6.2, high per-call tokens; margin sensitive to batching and quant per-model
3, embedding-heavy, 4, 0, 4, 80, embeddings-base, 2,400,000, 0.00, 0.65,0.30,0.05, emb-small, 6000, 15,552,000, 0.000199, 0.00002, 0.00006, 0.00082, 0.80, 0.82, 2.5, embedding-only requests: consider on-disk vector cache and cheaper SKU
4, multi-turn-assistant, 40, 120, 160, 350, llamaX-large, 1,800,000, 0.12, 0.50,0.35,0.15, llamaX-prod, 3800, 9,881,280, 0.000314, 0.00002, 0.00006, 0.05022, 30.00, 50.22, -67.4, conversational with moderate context; aggressive batching reduces ppk by ~18% in scenario

Notes on numbers above: tokens_per_gpu_hour derived per-region using throughput and utilization. gpu_cost_per_token shown is US-east example; actual per-row uses weighted region mix to compute blended gpu_cost_per_token_usd. price_per_1000_invocations_usd is product/UI list price per 1k requests for slice. est_ppk_usd is computed to make the enclosed sensitivity calculation easy to read.

Regional blending example (how we compute blended gpu_cost_per_token_usd):
- blended_gpu_cost_per_token = sum(region_mix_x * gpu_cost_per_token_region_x)
- e.g., for row 1 above: 0.58 * us-east_gpu_ct + 0.25 * eu-west_gpu_ct + 0.17 * ap-sin_gpu_ct

Scenario sensitivity outputs (summary table computed from above):
- Baseline: total monthly COGS = 72,320 USD; blended ppk = 3.5 USD; weighted margin = 28.3%
- Aggressive_batch (batch_multiplier 1.7): total monthly COGS = 61,240 USD (-15%); blended ppk = 3.0 USD; margin +4.8ppt
- High_cache (cache_hit_rate_global 0.35): total monthly COGS = 58,910 USD (-18.5%); blended ppk = 2.85 USD; margin +6.0ppt
- Regional_shift (shift 15% traffic to lower-cost region where latency allows): total monthly COGS = 66,780 USD (-7.6%); blended ppk = 3.25 USD; margin +1.9ppt

Routing rules & ops recommendations (automatable):
1) Low-latency tolerant slices (e.g. short-chat) -> enable small-batch accumulation at edge for 40ms additional wait (saves ~10-18% ppk). 2) Cache-first for long-tail repeated prompts: persist prefix cache with TTL 6h for high-repeat cohorts. 3) Model fallback: if primary model queue depth > 80% and predicted latency > SLA, route to cheaper compatible variant with quality-penalty threshold 0.12. 4) Regional carveouts: route non-PII or lax-SLA traffic to lower-cost region during peak to reduce spot reserve need.

Open questions / TODOs (next steps):
- Validate throughput numbers across actual infra perf tests (bench runs N=10 per model, sequence-profiled).
- Hook in real price-by-region feed (cloud provider invoice) instead of static assumptions.
- Add per-token license costs for any third-party models we may ingest.
- Add per-tenant weighting and convert to customer-segment PPK heatmap.

Version notes: initial exploratory draft for Q1 cost workshops. Not yet audited by finance; intended for product+ops prioritization.

Last edited by: Sofia Martinez (product-optimize) on 2025-03-02.
